not_confirmed_list.value: Brightwater Valve Works designs and manufactures butterfly and ball valves for chemical plants and refineries.
Marisol Valvulas manufactures industrial gate and globe valves for the oil and gas industry and exports to customers across Europe.
Hansa Valve Supply is an independent distributor of industrial valves from European manufacturers, keeping more than 20,000 items in stock. It states that it does not manufacture valves itself.
Baltic Forge Software develops quality-control and traceability software for metalworking factories, working with manufacturers across the Baltics and the Nordics.
